name: Secured Credit Agreement
description: A legal contract detailing the terms, conditions, parties, and financial definitions of a secured term credit arrangement.
key_questions: Who are the parties to this credit agreement (Borrower, Administrative Agent, Lenders)?
What is the effective date or signature date of the agreement?
What is the primary purpose of the loans being financed?
What specific technical or financial indices are defined in this agreement?
What are the key definitions (e.g., benchmark rates, reserve funds) governing this credit arrangement?
